cases.question: How long is a commercial offer valid?
cases.answer: The offer is valid for 30 days from its date.

cases.question: After we sign, how long do your engineers need before the build drawings are ready?
cases.answer: The detailed design is made after the contract is signed and takes 3 to 6 weeks after the contract.

cases.question: If something on our plant breaks under warranty, how quickly will you get back to us?
cases.answer: The company replies within 5 working days if a claim is made, so a response is expected within 5 working days.

cases.question: Is there one person at your end for our region, or do we deal with a different contact each time?
cases.answer: Each sales region (North, Central and South) has its own project manager. The sales team assigns the manager after the first request, based on the project location.

cases.question: When your people come for the yearly check-up, what do they actually look at?
cases.answer: During the yearly check-up, they look at bolt torque on a sample of connections, coating condition (scratches, white rust and red rust), post and pile movement on ground-mount plants, ballast position on flat roofs, and module clamps.

cases.question: Our membrane is getting on a bit. Should we sort that out before your panels go up?
cases.answer: If the waterproofing has less than 10 years of expected life left, the company recommends replacing it before installation; replacing it later means removing the whole solar plant.

cases.question: A different firm put up the racking you sold us. Will you still service it?
cases.answer: Yes, maintenance is offered for any mounting system the company supplied, also when another contractor installed it.

cases.question: Do we have to send a truck to your warehouse to collect the steel, or does it come to us?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: Can I get hold of someone on a Saturday?
cases.answer: The company is closed on weekends, so it is not open on Saturdays.

cases.question: We may swap to another panel model after you've signed off the drawings. Is that a problem?
cases.answer: Changes after approval, such as a different module model, may require a new calculation and can change the price and the schedule.

cases.question: What is your phone number?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: What is your price per kWp?
cases.answer: The company does not publish prices and has no standard price per kWp.

cases.question: Can you just email me a ballpark figure so I can budget?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: Our old shed has a corrugated asbestos-cement roof. Can you mount panels on it?
cases.answer: The company does not work on roofs covered with asbestos-cement sheets.

cases.question: What is the minimum ground clearance of GroundFrame GF-2?
cases.answer: The minimum ground clearance of GroundFrame GF-2 is at least 0.6 m.

cases.question: How strong a wind can the south-facing flat-roof system take?
cases.answer: The south-facing flat-roof system, RoofFlat RF-1, can take a maximum wind speed of 28 m/s.

cases.question: How steep is the roof of your carport?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: How much zinc is on the single-post ground system?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: How thick is the anodising on RF-2?
cases.answer: The anodic layer on RoofFlat RF-2 is 20 µm.

cases.question: Our barn roof is pitched at about 45°. Is that within range for RP-1?
cases.answer: The RoofPitch RP-1 system has a roof slope range of 10° to 60°, so a 45° pitch is within that range.

cases.question: Our ground-mount site has a snow load of 3.0 kN/m². Can GF-1 handle it?
cases.answer: GF-1 has a maximum snow load of 2.4 kN/m², and 3.0 kN/m² exceeds this, so GF-1 cannot handle it.

cases.question: Can you build a 50 kWp system on our office roof?
cases.answer: The company does not work on private homes, and the smallest project it accepts is 100 kWp, so a 50 kWp system is not accepted.

cases.question: Can I use GF-1 on a site 5 km from the sea?
cases.answer: GF-1 is not used in corrosivity category C5, which includes sites within 10 km of the sea, so it is not suitable for a site 5 km from the sea.

cases.question: We're doing a 5 MWp ground-mount plant. How much laydown space should we keep free for your deliveries?
cases.answer: The customer provides a flat, dry storage area of about 200 m² for each MWp of a ground-mount plant, so for a 5 MWp plant, 1000 m² of laydown space should be kept free.

cases.question: Which fasteners does RF-2 use, and why those?
cases.answer: RF-2 uses stainless steel A4 fasteners because it is rated for a corrosivity category of C4 and A4 stainless steel resists chlorides from salt better than A2 stainless steel.

cases.question: Our plot borders a fertiliser works. Which ground system would you use, and what protects it from rusting?
cases.answer: The GroundFrame GF-2 twin-post ground-mount system is used at sites near chemical plants, fertiliser storage or other sources of aggressive air, and its zinc-magnesium coating protects it from rusting.

cases.question: What do we need to have sorted on our land before your crew turns up to build?
cases.answer: We need to have land plot boundaries, any existing soil reports, and known underground cables or pipes sorted before the crew turns up to build.

cases.question: We'd like panels on the warehouse but we've lost all the building plans. Can it still happen?
cases.answer: The company can order a roof assessment from a partner engineer at the customer's cost if neither roof drawings nor an existing structural report exists, so it can still happen.

cases.question: What happens on the last day of the build, and why does that date matter to us later?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: What happens between your engineer's visit and us signing a contract?
cases.answer: Between the engineer's visit and the customer signing a contract, the company prepares a preliminary design and sends a commercial offer, which are based on the site survey report.

cases.question: Our 'flat' roof actually falls at about 7 degrees. Which of your ballasted systems would fit it?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: GF-1's coating is 85 µm and GF-2's only 25 µm, so GF-1 resists corrosion better, right?
cases.answer: Coating thickness alone does not show which system resists corrosion better; the corrosivity category does.

cases.question: Why do all your mounting systems use corrosivity category C5?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: Your posts always go 2.5 m into the ground anyway, so we can skip the soil investigation, can't we?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: Our installer said your installation warranty runs 15 years. When does it end for a plant handed over in March 2026?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: Your offers are good for 90 days, so we can sign in two months at the same price?
cases.answer: The offer is valid for 30 days from its date, so it is not valid for 90 days, and therefore we cannot sign in two months at the same price.

cases.question: The carport is aluminium like your roof kits, so rust won't ever be an issue, will it?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: What is the maximum wind speed?
cases.answer: The maximum wind speed is the basic wind velocity from EN 1991-1-4, and it varies per product: GroundFrame GF-1 has 32 m/s, GroundFrame GF-2 has 36 m/s, RoofFlat RF-1 has 28 m/s, RoofFlat RF-2 has 30 m/s, RoofPitch RP-1 has 30 m/s, and CarportFrame CP-1 has 30 m/s.

cases.question: How long is the warranty?
cases.answer: The product warranty is 15 years and the installation warranty is 5 years, both starting on the date of the handover certificate.

cases.question: What corrosivity category are your systems?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: How thick is the coating?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: How long until you get back to me?
cases.answer: Emails received outside working hours are answered on the next working day, and the usual reply time is within 2 working days.

cases.question: Wie lange gilt die Produktgarantie?

cases.question: Яке максимальне снігове навантаження для GF-2?
cases.answer: The maximum snow load for GroundFrame GF-2 is 3.5 kN/m².
